name: Arc Elementalist
summary: Self-cast Arc on the Elementalist shell. Arc clears packs without aiming, the exposure and shock package turns lightning into a real single-target tool, and the gear is the same spell sceptre and shield the totem build uses. No required unique.

pros.text: Arc clears packs without precise aiming.
No required unique; spell damage and gem levels carry the build.
Elementalist exposure and shock improve the boss fight.
The same spell gear works for the totem and self-cast versions.
A simple first caster for a new league.
The build can pivot to a different lightning spell without new gear.

cons.text: Self-casting means you stand still for the damage.
Single-target needs the shock and exposure window.
Clear speed is slower than a bow or a well-geared melee build.
Mana is tight before leech and reduced cost are online.
Elemental reflect maps are a hard no.
A six-link is a large damage step.

pantheon.note: Gruthkul reduces the physical hits that catch a caster in a bad position.

summary.text: Arc Elementalist is a self-cast lightning build that measures 66.3k at red maps and 92.6k at pinnacle. Exposure and shock carry the single-target, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Rolling Magma, then switch to Arc as soon as it is available. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 49 damage; the second measures 512.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 66.3k damage, 18364 effective life and 5724 physical max hit. Keep the resistances capped and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 92.6k damage with 23368 effective life and 6065 physical max hit. Apply the shock and exposure before the burst, then move out of the slam.
